title: Settlement limits on what shops buy and stock
summary: A city's or town's size can now cap what its shops pay for one item and how rare the stock of new shops there can be. Both are yours to switch and adjust.
items: Turn on a per-item sale cap: shops in a small place refuse items worth more than its limit, or pay the limit instead, as you choose.
Suggested limits follow Pathfinder: a thorp pays at most 50 gp for one item, a small town 1,000 gp, a metropolis 16,000 gp.
New shops' generated stock stops at the place's rarest: hamlets common, villages uncommon, large towns rare, large cities magic. Items you add by hand are never limited.
Change any size's limit or rarest stock, or give one place its own, under Manage regions, cities, towns and areas.
Players see the limit in Why this payout? when they sell; shops already open keep their stock.
